title: Control flow: each, if, await and keyed blocks

videos.script:
Markup that only ever shows the same thing is a poster. {{poster}} Today the planner's markup starts making decisions.

If blocks choose. {{if}} The week is empty, or all done, or partly done, and the page says which. The order of the cases turns out to matter.

Each blocks repeat. {{each}} A line for every day of the week, and a variable declared right in the markup. It behaves exactly like one in the script, which is a trap you have met before.

Keys decide identity. {{keys}} You sort a list, and a note typed beside one session ends up beside another. One id in brackets fixes it.

Await blocks wait. {{await}} The planner's data moves behind an address, and the page asks for it. You will see the server refuse the request, and what the visitor sees while the browser waits.

And key blocks start over. {{key}} A form that forgets its date when the week changes, without knowing anything about weeks.
